title: Underflow occurs exactly at zero
statement: For every finite bit word $b$, the borrow pass started with borrow bit $1$ ends with borrow bit $1$ if and only if the little-endian value of $b$ is zero.
replaced:
For every bit word $w$, the borrow pass entered with a set borrow flag ends with a set
flag if and only if the little-endian value of $w$ is $0$; this holds also for words
padded with high zero bits.
